actual_animation_kind: Full procedural setupAnim read; flight/ground/tackle/idle/head tracking and explicit heartscale consumers. No missing external action file required. Not a rendered or runtime animation validation.

body.hierarchy: 11 parts root->body->wings/heart/legs/neck; legs->feet; neck->head. Body6x6x10 plus7x6x7 overlapping chest; neck3x3x8; head5x4x7 plus forward beak cuboids; wings24x0x14 planes with root struts7x2x2.128x128 declared UV.
body.interface: Head belongs under neck, heart under body; wings under body. No independent helditem/pendant object or new attack organ proposed. Model leftLeg has label leftWing in constructor; identity by variable/parent not label alone.

native_action_chain: Server tick valid livingtarget assigns PERCH_POS target.blockPosition.above7; absent target invalidates air perch against real perchblock rules, then searches actual perch. Target and perch are not same lifetime.

Flying switch installs custom MoveHelper+DirectPathNavigator, ground installs native MoveControl+GroundPathNavigatorWide. Both sides switch based synchronized flying. noGravity set flying later each tick on both sides. Switching controller/navigation does not explicitly clear deltaMovement.

shouldSwoop checks targetnonnull && tackleCooldown0 (no alivecheck here). AITackleMelee.canUse sets flyingtrue; MOVE+LOOK goal has no canContinue override. Native defaultcontinuation not read, so source cannot alone prove exact tick restart schedule.

AITackleMelee.tick sets TACKLING from flying then wanted target eyeXYZ speed2 and actor yaw toward target. Controller MOVE_TO separately accelerates normalized destination*.05*speed then sets actor/body yaw from velocity, so writer order matters; no guarantee always target-facing vs lateralvelocity.

Contact AABB inflate.3 intersects target AND cooldown0; sets cooldown100..299 BEFORE hurt, acceptedhurt optionally heals/increments soul if ownhealth<max-damage and soul<5. Then calls stop: TACKLINGfalse only. No velocity/path/flying clear and no independent delayed attack-contact frame.

AICirclePerch canUse !shouldSwoop/flying/perchnonnull. start random speed.8..1.2, Ylevel0..2, radius5..10, direction. maxCirclingTime360..439 assigned but tick uses literal360. Orbit angular3degrees*tick, integer block sampling, empty destination only; current target speed multiplier1.55.

AICirclePerch.stop rerandomizes orbit fields and sets tackleCooldown0, no velocity/controller clear. Thus aborting circle can erase attack cooldown; do not assume cooldown duration always retained. Native scheduling/externalinterrupt unverified.

After circlingTime>360 drives to perchY+1.1; verticalCollision OR distSquared<1 explicitly sets flyingfalse AND deltaMovementZERO, landingCooldown400..1599, calls stop. This landing transition has physical reset unlike ordinary goalstop. General verticalcollision can count; not proof correct perch contact.

MoveHelper arrival length<.3 WAIT and halve velocity; otherwise add acceleration and yaw fromvelocity. WAIT noexplicitclear. canReach helper defined but not invoked by tick; direct wanted path not claimed obstacle avoidance.

DirectPathNavigator.tick increments internaltick only; moveTo forwards straight wanted position, no path creation in these overrides. GroundPathNavigatorWide uses width*.75 and directiondot waypoint advance, native parents not closed.

AIFlyRandom stops cachedpoint only, omits explicit movementreset. Landing/noGravityfalse own tick is separate from TACKLING flag. No own hurt override to abort flight/pose, no authored death clip; inherited deathcontrol unverified.
actual_animation_and_order: Tick captures prevFlyProgress/prevTackleProgress BEFORE changes, then +/-1 clamped0..5. Model partial=ageInTicks-tickCount interpolates those. Unlike prior Mosquito endcapture, these hold previous state in own code.
setupAnim resets default pose each render. Flight adds bodyX+15, neckX-35, headX+25, legsX+55; wingsX-70/Yopposite90, wingposY-2/Z-1; bodyY+2, legsY-3/Z+1, headY+3/Z-2, each weightedprogress/5.

Tackle overlays bodyX-55,neckX-35,headX+90,legsX-100,legposY+3/Z-2. At fly5+tackle5 these offsets ADD: bodytotal-40,neck-70,head+115 before default/dynamic/headlook. Do not call each isolated value final world angle.

Flight branch bobbody.2/1.6, head/neckwalk.4, wingflap.4/1, lowleg limbwalk. Ground branch strongerlegwalk.7/.74 and smallbody/winggait. Idle heartbob/walk and neck/headwalkalways, then faceTarget(yaw,pitch,2,neck,head). Citadel divisor implementation not inspected; no exact perbone angle claim.

TACKLINGfalse ramps poseout over5updates through same blend then default reset; FLYINGfalse similarly blends to ground. Neither blend removes actor velocity. Heartscale explicit1+min(1,soul*.5) eachframe avoids accumulating scale but not proof all engine scales reset.
Root remains fixed24Y; flight/bodybob visual movement not server hover height. Headtracking over attackpose may change final gaze; no clipmask limits observed in own setupAnim.
render: Renderer shadow.3, scale override contains only commented1.2 and actually no scale. Glow layer alltimes uses AMRenderTypes.getGhost at packedlight240; optional soulheart adds three flame textures changing each3ticks (9tickcycle). getGhost139-142 uses eyes shader/noLightmap/equaldepth/noCull; GHOST_TRANSPARANCY setup not read. No PNG viewed or visualbrightness claim.
